description: Pinned CipherLayer Wallet browser-connect contract v0.1 consumed by the browser repo. Read-only copies; never edit in place. Family convention per operator decision 2026-07-04 (wallet register AC-001), Arrow/Tarquin PIN format.

pins.purpose: Browser-wallet protocol doc plus envelope, signing-request/response, dapp-permission, and wallet-capability schemas — the only interface through which this repo may talk to the wallet. v1.1: signing_request_id nullable for pre-Vault refusals. Refresh 2026-07-17: protocol v0.4 (ADR-019) — envelope v1.1 adds payload.kind typed_data/personal_message with typed_data_json/message_hex; signing-response v1.3 adds signature_hex; new rpc-query.v1 read-only whitelist proxy; v0.3 shapes unchanged (additive).

update_procedure: Re-copy from wallet exports/browser-connect-v<X>/ at a chosen commit; update source_commit, hashes, pinned_at; update docs referencing changed semantics; record breaking changes in an ADR.
